description: Return the published FairWhere answer for where to meet between two London neighbourhoods (winner venue, minutes, gap, top venues, citation URL). Use when the user asks “where should we meet between X and Y”. Do not invent a geographic midpoint.

areaA.description: First London neighbourhood slug or name (e.g. clapham or Clapham).

areaB.description: Second London neighbourhood slug or name (e.g. walthamstow).
